interpretation: The independent-block point estimate remains negative but is substantially attenuated relative to the published-style estimate, and its preregistered interval includes zero. The robustness stress test therefore does not support calling the published directional pattern robust to this measurement-artifact correction.
limitations: The source publication's assay-block exchangeability has not received independent domain-specialist review.
The preregistered errors-in-variables weighted sensitivity was not implemented before final evaluation; any later implementation must be exploratory and cannot revise the final primary disposition.
This computational result does not establish biological mechanism, causation, universal evolutionary predictability, or physical validation.
deviations: Preregistration v2 was a pre-final amendment that fixed the previously unspecified bootstrap and leave-out calculations; v1 remains preserved.
No post-final model was used to alter the primary result.
external_scrutiny: No independent statistician or microbial-evolution specialist review occurred.
No author contact or publication is authorized.
